basic_info.description: Opportunity Knocks at Millennium Tower - Residence 41D.  Don't miss your chance to own one of the most sought-after floor plans in San Francisco's premier high-rise. Perched on the coveted southeast corner of Millennium Tower, Residence 41D offers breathtaking views of the Bay Bridge and the shimmering city skyline. This pristine, move-in-ready 2 BR plus library / 3 full BA is priced to sell and will be delivered with fresh paint and brand-new carpeting. The expansive layout features elegant upgrades throughout, including custom designer lighting, pocket doors leading to the versatile library or home office. Built-in, wall-mounted speakers, sophisticated motorized window coverings & more! Enjoy luxurious living in one of the city's most iconic addresses, with world-class amenities, a full-service lifestyle, and unbeatable walkability in the heart of downtown.
